pipeline_name: Pochinki-Izobilnoe-North Stavropol Underground Gas Storage Pipeline

validity.recommendation: Do not change GEM's recorded Length=937.00 off this research alone -- no source stating a full end-to-end 937km figure was found -- but flag the aggregate-vs-segment risk for a future researcher: energybase.ru's dedicated page for this exact pipeline gives only 318km, and multiple independent sources (neftegaz.ru 2023-05-30: three separate Gazprom Transgaz subsidiaries -- Saratov, Stavropol, and per Volgograd Transgaz's own history page, Volgograd -- all operate LPUMGs along this corridor) indicate the true corridor spans at least 3 Gazprom Transgaz zones across multiple oblasts, so 318km is very plausibly a single zone/segment length, not the full trunk. GEM's 937.00 was neither confirmed nor contradicted by this research.

Length.note: energybase.ru value is very likely a single-zone/segment figure (Stavropol Transgaz zone only), not the full multi-oblast trunk; not used as a direct fill per the aggregate-vs-segment rule.

validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed real and distinct from sibling rows -- energybase.ru has its own dedicated page for 'Pochinki-Izobilnoye-SSPHG', Volgograd Transgaz's official history page independently names this exact pipeline and dates its 1998 commissioning, and neftegaz.ru independently confirms three separate Gazprom Transgaz subsidiaries actively maintain sections of it. CLASSIFICATION: correctly classed as a transmission pipeline feeding North Stavropol underground gas storage. DUPLICATE: not a duplicate of P0756/P2371/P2372 -- distinct destination (North Stavropol UGS in Stavropol Krai vs Gryazovets/Penza/Yaroslavl), distinct diameter reporting, distinct operating subsidiaries. ATTRIBUTION: ownership (Gazprom PJSC via Gazprom Transgaz Stavropol/Volgograd) is solid and corroborated by 2 independent subsidiary sources. SPEC: Diameter=1420mm confirmed (energybase.ru, medium tier, single source). Length=937.00 and Capacity=30.00 bcm/y COULD NOT be confirmed or contradicted -- both left UNRESOLVED as fills; Length carries this validity concern because the only length figure found (318km) is very likely a zone-segment measurement given the confirmed multi-subsidiary/multi-oblast corridor, and using it as a direct fill for a full-trunk Length cell would violate the aggregate-vs-segment rule. Net verdict: concern (spec, on Length only) rather than clean, but NOT an existence/duplicate/misclassification finding -- this is a legitimate, distinct, well-attested pipeline.

verifications.note: energybase.ru's dedicated 'Pochinki-Izobilnoye-SSPHG' pipeline page lists diameter 1420mm, an exact match to GEM's recorded 1420.

fills.researcher_notes: Single source (energybase.ru's own dedicated page for this exact pipeline, operated under Gazprom Transgaz Stavropol per its own listing). Searched for a second independent source specifically stating 1420mm for this corridor (as opposed to the separate/larger 'Southern Corridor' project); Gazprom Transgaz Stavropol's own site and Volgograd Transgaz's history page describe the pipeline but do not restate the diameter number, so staged at medium per rule 4(d).

GEM records 937.00 km for the full Pochinki-Izobilnoye-North Stavropol UGS pipeline. energybase.ru's dedicated page for this exact named pipeline gives only 318 km, which multiple corroborating sources (neftegaz.ru's 2023-05-30 report that THREE separate Gazprom Transgaz subsidiaries -- Saratov, Stavropol and, per Volgograd Transgaz's own official history page, Volgograd -- all operate LPUMGs along this same 'Pochinki-Izobilnoye-North Stavropol UGS' corridor) strongly suggest is only the Stavropol-zone segment of a much longer multi-oblast trunk, not the full length. No source stating the full 937km figure (or any other single end-to-end figure) was found despite searching Russian-language terms ('Починки Изобильное протяженность км', 'магистральный газопровod Починки-Изобильное-ССПХГ километров') and checking Gazprom Transgaz Saratov, Stavropol and Volgograd subsidiary sites. Per the standing aggregate-vs-segment rule, the 318km zone figure is NOT used as a fill for this row's full-trunk Length -- flagged instead as a validity concern. Left UNRESOLVED rather than fabricating or misapplying a segment figure.

GEM records 30.00 bcm/y. Searches (Russian and English) for 'Починки Изобильное производительность млрд куб м' and similar surfaced only capacity figures belonging to the separate, larger 'Southern Corridor'/Pochinki-Anapa gas transmission project (63 bcm/y system-wide design figure; also saw 31.5 bcm/y attributed to one Southern Corridor string), which must not be conflated with this Pochinki-Izobilnoye-North Stavropol UGS pipeline. No source found stating 30.00 bcm/y (or any other figure) specifically for this pipeline. Left UNRESOLVED.
